mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION ORDER BY suggested_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION (employee_no, manager_employee_no, product_name, suggestion_content, proposed_min_interest_rate, proposed_max_interest_rate) VALUES (#{dto.employee_no},#{dto.manager_employee_no}, #{dto.product_name},#{dto.suggestion_content}, #{dto.proposed_min_interest_rate}, #{dto.proposed_max_interest_rate})
mapper.select: SELECT s.suggestion_no, s.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.job_title, s.product_name, s.suggestion_content, s.proposed_min_interest_rate, s.proposed_max_interest_rate, s.approval_status, s.suggested_at, s.processed_at FROM TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION s JOIN TB_employee e ON s.employee_no = e.employee_no WHERE s.manager_employee_no = #{manager_employee_no} ORDER BY s.suggested_at DESC

SELECT s.suggestion_no, s.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.job_title, e.dept_no, s.manager_employee_no, m.employee_name AS manager_name, s.product_name, s.suggestion_content, s.proposed_min_interest_rate, s.proposed_max_interest_rate, s.approval_status, s.reject_reason, s.suggested_at, s.processed_at FROM TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION s JOIN TB_employee e ON s.employee_no = e.employee_no JOIN TB_employee m ON s.manager_employee_no = m.employee_no WHERE s.suggestion_no = #{suggestion_no}
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION SET approval_status = 'APPROVED', processed_at = SYSDATE
WHERE suggestion_no = #{suggestion_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_APPROVED_SUGGESTION (suggestion_no, rate_no, terms_no, description_no, condition_no) VALUES (#{suggestion_no}, null, null, null, null)
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_PRODUCTS_SUGGESTION SET approval_status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{reject_reason}, processed_at = SYSDATE
WHERE suggestion_no = #{suggestion_no}
